display.summary: The Options card tells the truth after an update: it stops advertising the release it is already running, and the Rollback button appears again on a Composer-executed stack. The titlebar's actions also become one ordered list that both layouts share.
highlights: Applying an update — from the panel or with `composer dlux-update apply` on the host — now clears the offer instead of leaving it on the card until the next check.
Rollback is offered again, naming the release Composer would actually bring back.
The reported latest version is unchanged; only the claim that it is installable goes away once it is installed.
Search, theme and language join the titlebar's orderable actions, and the order builder now works in the Dropdown layout too.
